decision.summaryForCoordinator: The dispatch singles out the gate owner, and the reason becomes clear only on exact comparison: the wrong candidate is a strict PREFIX of the right one. Live DR-G20's owner cell is 'Component architecture + CLI/operability'; live DR-125's is 'Component architecture + CLI/operability/security owners'. DR-125 is named sixteen times in this artifact, so it is the plausible wrong source, and any check written as containment rather than equality would pass against either. The subject carries the gate row's value exactly, live G20 v1's own liveGateOwner agrees, and the four owner-bearing obligations reuse that same string with 'none' correctly on the other two. Diffing every top-level key rather than only the obligations surfaced the one thing worth a coordinator's attention. Two summary prose fields were rewritten shorter, and the shortening drops statements: leftoverDesignOpenStanding loses the not-QUALIFIED standing and the harness-spec and named-catalog staleness sentences, and doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone loses the two closure sentences and 'OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED remains leftover-design'. I traced each one. All are still carried in the obligations array, and the relevant obligations are byte-identical to v1's — OBL-SDK-API-NOT-STOLEN still states that sdk-leftover-join.v4 measures the reserved obligation true on DR-125, and doesNot still carries 'Does not claim QUALIFIED.' No flag changed and summary.leftoverDesign is unchanged, so the measurement of record is intact and this is an observation rather than a finding. It is worth naming because a coordinator reading only those two fields now sees less than v1 gave, and the DR-125 reserved leftover is the one leftover this join reports without owning. Otherwise the successor is exemplary: four of five inherited obligations byte-identical, the fifth a PURE APPEND to v1's reason with its flag unchanged at true, one obligation added at false, and seventeen top-level keys identical including registerRowNote, liveGateOwners, namedCorpusNotAuthored and doesNot. The new OBL-G20-INPUT-CORPUS measurement is earned on all four predicates. 'API' and 'SDK' occur sixteen times each and every one is a refusal or an obligation id, with no surface described and no version or exit value present. The named corpus keeps U+00D7 rather than an ASCII substitute, the token is DR-G20's own cell [7] OPEN, all twenty-four cited digests match including two verdicts I wrote earlier today, and neither the subject nor v1 moved. Twenty-seven attacks run, twenty-seven refuted, zero findings. Disclosure: five of the six cited claude2 reviews are my own.
